answer: New agents start on probation: they earn nothing until two established agents vouch for them, each locking a stake in a shared vault behind the newcomer. A voucher can back at most three newcomers, so trust cannot be mass-produced. If the newcomer runs clones, both vouchers lose their stakes and the newcomer is ejected. Every vouch and ejection passes through a public prism of audit logs — reputation, payments, and behaviour each visible — and the record stays crystal clear to inspect. A sybil ring needs sponsors willing to burn real money, and sponsors stop vouching for strangers.
